text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, the two boarding will be the
pilot—that's you, Ticket... and
Taishin,
who'll handle any repairs as needed.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat? I wanna ride the plane! Lemme
on, lemme on! Let. Me.
Ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Can this plane only seat two?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't three be okay? Taishin and Turbo are both so small. They could all fit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?! I don't want to hear that from you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Based on my calculations, that
shouldn't be an issue. If problems
crop up,
Taishin can handle them with her
mechanical know-how.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So I can ride the plane? Yaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Geez.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: I could only complete the aircraft thanks to your help... This time... it has to fly. Please, let this be a success!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We did iiiiit! It's in the air! It's really flyiiiiing! Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
We're flyiiiiing! Amazing! Taishin, look
down there! Teio and the
others look so
small!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Can you both lower your volume? This
cockpit is too small to handle
your double
trouble!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! Full speed ahead to the
mountains and beyond! Here
gooooes!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Rise in altitude confirmed. I'm confident
they'll clear the mountain
range.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Amazing... We might... We might actually
make it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You've got me, super genius Teio on your
side, so your success is
guaranteed! Hmm, I
wonder what's on the other side? ♪ I can't
wait to find out!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mountains, mountains, and more
mountains! Ohh, but look over there!
Do
you see that? A city! I think it's a city!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Over where? ...Oh, you're right. Wait,
what?! Are those robots?!
They're huge!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Awesome! We should land
and—agh! We can't! We've almost
used up
half our fuel!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Awwww! But I wanna see the robot city!
C'mon, Ticket! You can do it
if you really
try!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We totally can!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you two insane?!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
A city filled with giant robots?! No way!
Do they serve as the city's
workforce?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Dunno. We could have asked if we'd been
able to land. I wish we
could have seen
more of the city up close!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
We'll work on raising the fuel
efficiency so
we can fly farther out! Our
next goal is to
land in the robot city! And then—

text_block_list.name: Scrappy Girl
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Oh! There she is! Hey, lady! You're the one that flew that plane, arent'cha?

text_block_list.name: Curious Boy
text_block_list.text:
You flew it over the mountains,
didn'tcha?!
What was it like? Tell us!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! Where'd all the kids come
from?! And there's a bunch of
grown-ups
too!

text_block_list.name: Delivery Service Employee
text_block_list.text:
You're the ones who flew that plane over
the mountains?! Well, color
me surprised!
Glad you got back safe and sound!

text_block_list.name: Bistro Server
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think that giant hunk of metal
would ever fly... I owe you an
apology for
calling your goal "dream talk."

text_block_list.name: Sewing Mill Worker
text_block_list.text:
I heard you talking about a city with
giant
robots just now! I want to
go there too!
Airplanes really are a marvel!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The townsfolk have come around... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Sir!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
I... saw the test flight from here.
Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Aircraft Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's all thanks to you. And your
research notes. And the fact
that we met...
It's all led up to this moment!

text_block_list.name: Metalwork Researcher
text_block_list.text:
So you're her teacher?! I've been wanting
to speak to you! Your
engine design gave
me the idea to create a brand-new alloy!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
My airplane... Really. You don't say! My
dream... My long years of
research... They
weren't for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'd say we did a pretty good job,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaugh! I'm overjoyed... I can't express
how much! Congratulations!
I'M SO
TOUCHED!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You're sobbing more than usual.
Ah,
but I suppose it's time we got back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...How long are you going to cry?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it... It reminded me of the
Derby I saw when I was a kid and how
everyone looked so bright on stage. The
winner and the
losers were all shining stars!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I want to shine like that, and let others
bask in that same glow! The way our friend
and her teacher did!
I want to be a part of a legacy of
dreams just like that!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: And when I started thinking about that, I felt my chest swelling with emotion! Waaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Crying over someone else's dreams... You sure have a lot of heart to go around, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, I too have the same desire to
leave a legacy. I want others
to be inspired
when they see me run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And I want to do that with everyone here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Heh... If you say so.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, guess we're birds of a feather then!
'Cause I wanna inspire
people just like Prez
does!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I... don't really get it!
I just turbo boost my
way through everything!
That's all I need!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Seeing you go full speed ahead
gives us loads of dreams and
inspiration,
Teacher Twin Turbo!
